# sendgrid_template_version (Resource)

Manages a version of a SendGrid dynamic template. Versions are immutable — changing content forces replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `html_content` (String) The HTML body of the email (supports Handlebars).
- `name` (String) The name of this version.
- `subject` (String) The subject line (supports Handlebars).
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the parent template.

### Optional

- `active` (Number) Whether this version is active (1) or inactive (0).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The version ID.
- `updated_at` (String) The last time this version was updated.
